q: A death-row prisoner files mercy plea and the jail asks you to escort for execution next week despite plea pending before the constitutional head.
options: Proceed with execution as trial is final
Defer execution, report pendency through chain and await decision
Execute secretly to avoid pressure
Release prisoner on your own till decision
expl: Pending mercy must be awaited; hasty execution violates procedure.
why: Clemency power is high constitutional remedy to correct miscarriage. On escort duty the SI must protect life pending decision, not pre-empt it.
trapnote: Trap: trial finality ignores pending mercy.

q: A local neta presses you to recommend mass release of his supporters, promising Governor will sign blindly and courts cannot question.
options: Forward false good-conduct report as ordered
Submit truthful record; clemency reviewable only for mala fide, not routine politics
Release them on parole yourself
Threaten warden to alter records
expl: Pardon is reviewable for mala fide or irrelevant grounds.
why: Clemency is executive grace subject to limited judicial check for arbitrariness. On report duty the SI must record facts faithfully and let lawful consideration follow.
trapnote: Trap: clemency pitched as unreviewable political favour.

q: A new ordinance on loudspeakers is flashed on WhatsApp. Shopkeepers ask if you will enforce it today on nakabandi.
options: Enforce WhatsApp copy immediately with fines
Verify promulgation and text through gazette and superiors before enforcement
Ignore all ordinances as temporary laws
Detain violators under ordinance without reading limits
expl: Ordinance has law force only after valid promulgation.
why: Ordinance power allows urgent law-making subject to satisfaction and legislative control. On road the SI must check authenticity and brief staff on exact prohibitions.
trapnote: Trap: social media copy treated as promulgated law.

q: The state head seeks your security report to decide sanction to prosecute a sitting minister in a corruption trap. The minister threatens you for adverse report.
options: Give clean report to avoid trouble
Give fearless factual report; sanction decision rests on lawful consideration
Refuse report saying sanction is political
Leak report to press to be safe
expl: Sanction needs independent application of mind on evidence.
why: Governor acts on constitutional advice but sanction requires legal scrutiny of material. On enquiry the SI must preserve evidence and submit impartial findings.
trapnote: Trap: threat or politics to distort sanction report.

q: During Vice-Presidential poll duty as Returning staff helper, an MLA asks you to disclose ballot and promises money. He says vacancy has stalled all second-office functions.
options: Show ballot to help voter and accept help
Maintain secrecy of ballot, brief on procedure, vacancy does not stall duties as acting arrangement continues
Stop poll till vacancy clarified
Allow open voting to speed up
expl: Ballot secrecy is mandatory and vacancy is filled by acting discharge.
why: Election to high offices follows secret ballot and continuity is ensured despite vacancy. On poll duty the SI must prevent disclosure and report bribery attempt.
trapnote: Trap: vacancy panic to breach ballot secrecy.
